subject: Instrumentation checkpoint + escalation matrix for Loom Health onboarding
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@loomhealth.com>, Loom Health SRE <devops@loomhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Instrumentation checkpoint + escalation matrix for Loom Health onboarding

Hi Alice / Loom SRE team —

Following our kickoff, attaching the preliminary artifacts we'll use to align on dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, and alert routing. High level asks for this week: 

- Confirm which production services you want immediate dashboards for (auth, inference, embedding-ingest).
- Confirm retention and PII redaction requirements for traces/logs (we need this for the SOC2 evidence).
- Identify SRE and app owners who will be primary alert receivers and who's on-call for weekends.

Proposed short plan (2-week sprint):
1) Today — inventory + owner confirmation (you)
2) +3 days — initial dashboard and tracing hook PRs (Redwood infra)
3) +6 days — runbook draft and alert thresholds (joint review)
4) +10 days — canary alerts and escalation run-through with your SREs

Attached: observability-handbook-v1.md (inventory and recommended dashboards), runbook-template.yml, and a dashboard-inventory.csv. Also shared a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ObsOnboard

Can you confirm owners and any mandatory compliance constraints by EOD Friday so we can lock the runbook?

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

[attachment: runbook-template.yml (3 KB)]
[attachment: dashboard-inventory.csv (2 KB)]

From: Alice Park <alice@loomhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Loom Health SRE <devops@loomhealth.com>, procurement@loomhealth.com
Date: 2025-10-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Instrumentation checkpoint + escalation matrix for Loom Health onboarding

Thanks Irene — this looks good. A few initial notes from our side: 

- Owners: app team will own inference and embedding-ingest (I'll loop Marcos and Priya); platform team will own auth and network-level alerts (cc'd SRE).
- Retention/PII: we need traces to be scrubbed of full-text patient identifiers; we can provide a regex-based redaction list. Long-term retention for traces should be 30 days; logs 90 days.
- SOC2: procurement asked for a SOC2 artifact and a short description of where audit logs will be stored for a third-party review. Can you include an export path in the runbook?

We can do the +10-day run-through on Tue 10/21. I'm available 10:00–12:00 PST.

Onwards —
Alice
Alice Park | Head of Product, Loom Health
[Note: cc'd devops for visibility]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@loomhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Instrumentation checkpoint + escalation matrix for Loom Health onboarding

On Wed, Oct 14, 2025 at 09:20, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Following our kickoff, attaching the preliminary artifacts...

Hi all — quick technical replies and actionables: 

- Redaction: we have a tracing-filter stage that can apply regex-based redaction before traces leave your VPC. Ben will own the redaction config; we'll need your sample PII patterns.
- Dashboards: proposing an initial set: "Inference Latency (p50/p95/p99)", "KV Cache Hit Rate", "Request Rate by API Key", "Failed Responses by Error Class". I'll push a staging dashboard and share the link.
- Alerts: propose an escalation matrix in the runbook: Page -> PagerDuty escalation (30 min) -> Ops group -> Engineering oncall; Email -> CS on-call -> AM. Thresholds: p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 10m. Open to tuning after canary.

Attachments: runbook-template.yml (draft with escalation matrix), dashboard-inventory.csv (populated).

Ben Carter
Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

[attachment: dashboard-inventory.csv (2 KB)]

Date: 2025-10-16T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Instrumentation checkpoint + escalation matrix for Loom Health onboarding

Thanks everyone — scheduling note: we created a staging dashboard and a short PR that adds the tracing hook to the /v1/generate path. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ObsOnboard (see /staging/dashboards).

Proposed workshop: Tue 2025-10-21 10:00–11:00 PST — agenda: walkthrough dashboards, runbook escalation paths, redaction patterns, and a short exec summary for procurement. I'll send a calendar invite and include the PR and the runbook draft.

If Loom SRE can share sample logs and 1–2 trace examples, Ben and I will pre-seed the redaction rules before the workshop.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
